ios.desc:
iglu is the new and better way to journal: micro-journaling. Record your life as it happens and come back to revisit with our AI-powered feed and semantic search. And most importantly, without sacrificing your privacy.

Building a journaling habit has never been this easy!

MICRO-JOURNALING
Forget sitting down and writing everything at once — that’s boring. Instead, write short entries (like tweets) on the go, as you move through your day. Micro-journaling makes both writing and exploring a breeze!

THREADS
Fully express your most intricate chain of thought by making threads with your entries. You can write as many nested entries as you want, and they will always be linked together.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Rediscover your older entries with iglu’s recommendations, selected by our AI based on what you’ve been writing recently. It’s a fun way to explore and get insights into yourself.

SEMANTIC SEARCH
Looking for an entry but don’t remember the exact words you wrote? Don’t worry, iglu’s semantic search engine gets the general idea of what you’re looking for and shows you the most relevant entries.

WRITE SHORTCUT
A new entry is always one tap away with iglu’s shortcut. Use it from the Action button, Lock Screen (as a control and as a widget), and Control Center. Say goodbye to friction!

ACTIVITY WIDGET
Keep track of your writing activity with the activity widget. It shows how much you’ve written in the past few weeks using a beautiful ‘heat map’ design, right on your Home Screen.

FACE ID
Lock iglu with Face ID to make sure no one snoops around your personal space.

JOURNALING REMINDERS
Get reminded to take a few seconds to journal every now and then. You can get reminders randomly throughout the day or choose specific times you prefer.

PRIVACY
Your journal is stored on your device. Entries and photos can sync with your private iCloud storage; videos remain on your device. Search and recommendations run on your device, and your journal content and search terms are not sent to Aptabase or RevenueCat. We use Aptabase for usage analytics without persistent user or device identifiers, and RevenueCat to manage purchases and subscriptions. Referrals use app-specific iCloud identifiers to award credits. Learn more: https://iglu.website/privacy

ACCESS AND PURCHASES
Access to all features requires a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

quotes.text:
Hey Hacker News!

I've built an iOS app called iglu to make journaling easy and engaging.

Write short entries, make threads with them, search them by meaning, and revisit them through intelligent recommendations related to your recent writing — all that with on-device, non-generative AI. iglu is the most private journaling app out there.

We use on-device, non-generative AI to power:

• Semantic search. If you're looking for something you wrote but don't remember the exact words, you can describe the general theme or topic of the entry you're looking for, and iglu will find it for you — it understands the meaning of what you write!

• Intelligent recommendations. When you're not looking for anything specific or just want a feed to scroll through, check out the 'Explore' tab. You'll find recommendations of older entries that iglu thinks are related to what you've been writing recently. It's a fun and easy way to remember and revisit your life!

iglu protects and respects your privacy:

• No accounts. That's right; you won't have to sign up or tell us your name or e-mail. We don't collect any data. We have no idea who's using iglu.

• Everything runs on-device. We don't even have servers.

• iCloud backup. Your data only lives on your phone and your personal iCloud account (as an encrypted backup).

• Face ID locking. By default, iglu is locked behind Face ID.

I'm excited to get feedback and opinions from the community — please share your thoughts!

Cheers!

Rafa Guimarães
